description: IAM session JWTs (sts.jwt): compact JWS with protected header {"alg","kid","typ":"biam-session+jwt"} (jose SignJWT member order), signed with Ed25519 (EdDSA, deterministic) or P-256 (ES256). Verification enforces typ, the alg allowlist pinned per kid, the exact issuer, one configured audience, exp/nbf with 5 s tolerance (signer) and the lifetime cap; failures are SessionTokenError (code INVALID_SESSION_TOKEN, status 401) with a reason. ES256 signatures are randomized: those cases keep the token from the previous generation as long as the TypeScript verifier still accepts it.

cases.nondeterministic: ECDSA signature; verify, do not compare
